role: the 256^2 panel's validation-selected fno configuration, retrained at 2048^2 (inside p2048b's H200 allocation)
timed_region: supplied on-device initial field and viscosity to on-device complete trajectory
host_transfer: separately timed device-to-host copy of the finished trajectory
retained: every individual repetition is stored in the npz beside this file
deviation: second process in the same Slurm allocation on the same GPU, after the JAX phase exited; the source protocol times all models in one process
scientific_status: same-allocation, same-GPU timing against the JAX subjects of this job; no ratio is taken against any other job
